notice: Light news day — fewer fresh items than usual.

lead.title: OpenAI pulls in another $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
lead.summary: OpenAI has raised roughly $11 billion so far in an ongoing round that values the lab at $1.25 trillion, per Bloomberg, with the total expected to approach $20 billion when it closes in the coming weeks. The news lands amid AI market jitters following the worst US chip sell-off since 2020.

top_stories.title: Tau Robotics humanoids clean San Francisco homes with remote human guidance
top_stories.summary: MIT Technology Review spent a day with Tau Robotics' invite-only humanoid cleaning service, where robots vacuum and wash up while teleoperated by humans — and every visit doubles as training data.

top_stories.title: Nvidia tightens AI GPU tracking in Southeast Asia to curb chip smuggling
top_stories.summary: Southeast Asian cloud providers will have to join Nvidia's Fleet Intelligence tracking program to qualify for Cloud Partner status, following scrutiny over Chinese chip smuggling through the region.

top_stories.title: Global chip rout spreads to Europe after worst US semiconductor sell-off since 2020
top_stories.summary: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 12.2% on November 5, its worst one-day drop since 2020, and the sell-off spread to Asian and European markets on November 6, with the DAX down 1.6%.

items.title: Qwen3.8-27B climbs Hugging Face trending with ~6.8M monthly downloads
items.summary: Alibaba's 27.8B-parameter image-text-to-text model sits near the top of Hugging Face trending as the mid-size workhorse of the Qwen3.8 family, and community GGUF builds are already appearing.

items.title: InternScience ships Sage-A1.5, a new open-weights science model
items.summary: Sage-A1.5 appears high on Hugging Face trending, marking a fresh open-weights entry in the science-oriented model space.

items.title: fishaudio's drama-3 trends as a new open speech release
items.summary: The newest iteration of Fish Audio's open speech models is trending, another sign of the fast release cadence in open voice generation.

items.title: Goethe: infrastructure for self-hosted AI
items.summary: A Show HN project providing infrastructure for running self-hosted AI services, positioned as an open alternative for users who want to own their AI stack.

items.title: Promptcheckup runs pass/fail checks on prompt changes
items.summary: An open-source tool that applies statistical pass/fail checks to prompt changes, reporting results with 95% confidence intervals to catch regressions.

items.title: Speedrunner cuts CLI startup time by 4.5x
items.summary: A Show HN tool that reduces CLI invocation overhead by 4.5x while producing identical output, aimed at scripts that spawn many CLI processes.

items.title: Cinnamon is a household AI agent with shared context and memories
items.summary: A home-focused agent built around shared context and persistent memories for household members rather than a single-user assistant.

items.title: AJX shows where AI agents get stuck in your product
items.summary: An analytics tool that surfaces the points in a product where AI agents fail or stall, aimed at teams building agent-friendly software.
